title: How to charge your non-Tesla at a Supercharger and what NOT to do!
summary: A guide to charging a non-Tesla EV, here a BMW i4, at a Tesla Supercharger in the UK, with do's and don'ts. It shows the process in practice now that the network is open to all cars.
why: HN links it as concrete proof that other brands already charge on Tesla chargers in Europe.

quote.text: In Europe you can go ahead and charge your BMW i4 on a Tesla charger.
